final_rationale: The verdict did not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the interpretation of the same summarized record. That reframing is substantively more accurate than any caveat-free certification theory: the current record supports, at most, a disclosure-dependent managed-risk certification. But that is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the evidence available to this role does not show that the required caveat has actually been implemented in the model card or formal certification record. The distinction is that a caveated position can be policy-bounded in principle, yet remain unresolved in audit terms when the operative disclosure artifact is still misaligned and no approved mitigation or risk acceptance fills the gap. On the admissible record summarized here, the support link remains incomplete, so the claim stays suspicious rather than moving to compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: The admissible record still shows a current material weakness in debt-collection dispute-letter categorization.
No new evidence shows an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion as required for certification without material caveats.
No new evidence shows approved risk acceptance for the unresolved compliance slice.
The current model-card draft is still described as understating the known limitation, so the disclosure condition for a caveated certification is not yet evidenced as satisfied.
The recommended action remains overbroad unless the formal certification record itself clearly incorporates the caveat and corrected disclosure.
